units.source_text: 疲劳在眼睛的深处，变成淡淡的光点漂散开来。

en.t: Deep in his eyes, the fatigue turned into faint points of light and drifted apart.

units.source_text: 他情不自禁地站下脚，眼睛紧紧盯着幽暗沙丘的表面。

en.t: Without thinking, he stopped in his tracks, his eyes fixed tightly on the surface of the dim sand dune.

units.source_text: 任何活动的东西，在他眼里看来，竟都成了斑蝥。

en.t: Anything that moved, as he saw it, had somehow turned into a blister beetle.
